SELECT d.analysis_id AS analysisId, d.analysis_date AS analysisDate, d.subbarcode AS subbarcode, d.subbarcode AS barcode, d.product_bio AS product, d.drive_status AS driveStatus, d.drive_executed_at AS driveExecutedAt, s.customer_name AS customerName, s.patient_name AS patientName, s.sample_type AS sampleType, s.erp_test_name AS erpTestName, r.report_id AS reportId, r.report_name AS reportName, r.analysis_disease AS analysisDisease, r.report_status AS reportStatus, r.report_interpreted_by AS interpreter, u.nick_name AS interpreterName, r.report_interpreted_at AS reportInterpretedAt, r.report_bioinfo_viewed_by AS bioinfoViewedBy, uv.nick_name AS bioinfoViewedByName, r.report_bioinfo_viewed_at AS bioinfoViewedAt, r.report_bioinfo_reviewed_by AS bioinfoReviewedBy, ur.nick_name AS bioinfoReviewedByName, r.report_bioinfo_reviewed_at AS bioinfoReviewedAt, r.report_generated_by AS reportGeneratedBy, ug.nick_name AS reportGeneratedByName, r.report_generated_at AS reportGeneratedAt, r.report_checked_by AS reportCheckedBy, uc.nick_name AS reportCheckedByName, r.report_checked_at AS reportCheckedAt, r.report_sent_by AS reportSentBy, us.nick_name AS reportSentByName, r.report_sent_at AS reportSentAt, SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.report_file_path, '/', -1) AS reportFilePdfName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.report_signed_file_path, '/', -1) AS reportSignedFileName, r.report_sign_started_at AS reportSignStartedAt, r.report_sign_time AS reportSignedAt, r.report_revert_from AS revertFrom,
GREATEST(COALESCE(d.update_time, d.create_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(r.update_time, r.create_time, '1970-01-01'), COALESCE(s.update_time, s.create_time, '1970-01-01')) AS latestUpdateTime FROM analysis_data d LEFT JOIN sample_file s ON s.id = (SELECT MAX(s2.id) FROM sample_file s2 WHERE s2.subbarcode = d.subbarcode AND s2.del_flag = '0') LEFT JOIN analysis_report r ON r.report_id = (SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM analysis_report r2 WHERE r2.analysis_id = d.analysis_id AND r2.del_flag = '0') LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = r.report_interpreted_by LEFT JOIN sys_user uv ON uv.user_id = r.report_bioinfo_viewed_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ur ON ur.user_id = r.report_bioinfo_reviewed_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ug ON ug.user_id = r.report_generated_by LEFT JOIN sys_user uc ON uc.user_id = r.report_checked_by LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON us.user_id = r.report_sent_by WHERE d.del_flag = '0'
